Description: Allows caster to work with non-magic liquids
Allows caster to make one dose of a potion that can have a first level spell imbedded in it. The caster must also cast an Imbed spell to place the spell into the potion
Allows caster to safely handle, prepare, and process minor poisons
As Work Liquid, except allows caster to work with nonmagic gas
As Potion I, except up to a second level spell can be imbedded
As Potion I, except up to a third level spell can be imbedded
As Minor Poison, except works with all but the most deadly poisons
As Potion I, except up to a fourth level spell can be imbedded
As Potion I, except up to a fifth level spell can be imbedded
As Potion I, except up to a seventh level spell can be imbedded
As Potion I, except up to a ninth level spell can be imbedded
As Potion I, except up to a tenth level spell can be imbedded
As Major Poison, except works with all poisons

As Potion I, except allows a Potion # spell to be used to create multiple doses. For example, a Potion V could be used to create 5 doses of a first level spell, or 1 dose of a 3rd lvl spell and 1 dose of a 2nd or 2 doses of a 2nd lvl spell and 1 dose of a 1st or etc
As Potion I, except up to a twentieth level spell can be imbedded. SPECIAL NOTES See Section 7.4 for more information on alchemy. LIQUID-GAS SKILLS
